items.titleEn: The possibility of a forced sale of Manchester City to an English football regulator.
items.summaryEn: BBC Sport reported that David Coogan, the head of the independent regulator of English football, was speaking in Parliament about the club's readiness to take action against Manchester City if the conviction of the club for breaching the Premier League's financial rules were confirmed.
